paywall:title.value: {count, plural, one {You just learned # country.} other {You just learned # countries.}}
paywall:title.value__note: Page 1 headline, shown right after the taster lesson. States what the user DID, not what they could buy. ICU plural — a taster can legitimately cover one country.
paywall:body.value: In a week of five-minute days, that's about thirty. WorldQuest keeps every one of them fresh.
paywall:body.value__note: Page 1 body. Extrapolates the user's own result. Never a promise we cannot keep — thirty is arithmetic, not marketing.
paywall:title.more__note: Page 2 headline. Deliberately modest: the learning is free and stays free, so this cannot claim to unlock it.
paywall:body.free__note: The most important line on the paywall. Premium sells depth and delight, never access to learning. Must appear on the plans page too.
paywall:perk.hearts__note: Premium benefit. Hearts never block learning — practice mode is always free — so this is convenience, not access.
paywall:perk.offline__note: Premium benefit: download packs to learn with no connection. Max 18 characters.
paywall:perk.stats__note: Premium benefit: retention curves and per-region breakdowns. Max 18 characters.
paywall:title.plans: Try it free for a week.
paywall:title.plans__note: Page 3 headline. Leads with the trial, not the price.
paywall:plan.annual__note: Plan label. Pre-selected — the cheaper per-month option, and the honest default.
paywall:plan.monthly__note: Plan label. The anchor the yearly saving is measured against. Always selectable.
paywall:plan.perMonth__note: Price line under a plan. {price} is a store-formatted, localised amount — never assembled from a number and a currency symbol.
paywall:plan.billedYearly__note: Clarifies that the monthly-equivalent figure above is charged once a year. Required for honesty and by both stores.
paywall:plan.save__note: Shown on the yearly plan. {percent} is computed from the two real prices — never a fixed marketing number.
paywall:title.buy__note: Page 3 headline when no trial is on offer — the user has spent theirs, or the store returned no prices. Must not promise a trial that will not appear at the till.
paywall:plans.loading__note: Shown while the store is being asked for prices. Prices are never guessed or hardcoded — they come from the store for the account actually being charged.
paywall:plans.offline: Prices come from the App Store, so they need a connection. Everything you've learned works offline as usual.
paywall:plans.offline__note: Shown on the plans page with no connection. Ends on what still works — being on a train is not an error and must not read like one.
paywall:plans.failed: We couldn't reach the store just now. Nothing was charged.
paywall:plans.failed__note: Shown when the store could not be reached. The second sentence matters more than the first: the immediate fear is being charged for nothing.
paywall:plans.none: There's nothing to buy here yet. Every lesson is free in the meantime.
paywall:plans.none__note: Shown when the store answers with no products — a configuration problem on our side, never the user's. Says so without alarming anyone.
paywall:cta.trial__note: Primary button when a trial is available. First person, because the user is choosing rather than being sold to. Max 22 characters.
paywall:cta.buy__note: Primary button when the user has already used their trial. Max 16 characters.
paywall:terms.trial: Free for 7 days, then {price}. Cancel any time in Settings — we'll remind you two days before.
paywall:terms.trial__note: Trial terms in plain words, above the button, not hidden in a link. The reminder promise is real and scheduled; do not write it unless it is.
paywall:dismiss__note: Dismisses the paywall. Always visible, never delayed, never a faint X in a corner. Max 12 characters.
paywall:restore__note: Required by both stores. Reachable from the paywall and from Settings.
paywall:adult.title: Ask a grown-up
paywall:adult.title__note: Parental gate headline, shown instead of the paywall on an under-13 account. Warm, not a barrier — the child has done nothing wrong.
paywall:adult.body: Buying things needs a grown-up. Show them this screen and they can take it from here.
paywall:adult.body__note: Parental gate body. Addressed TO THE CHILD, in their words, explaining rather than refusing. Never implies they are missing out.
paywall:adult.continue__note: Dismisses the parental gate straight back to the app. The child loses nothing by pressing it. Max 16 characters.
paywall:billing.title: Your payment didn't go through
paywall:billing.title__note: Shown when the store reports a failed renewal. States the fact without blame — the usual cause is an expired card, not the user. NEVER 'Your subscription has been cancelled'; it has not.
paywall:billing.body: Your card was declined, so Premium's extras are paused. Everything you've learned is safe — updating your payment brings the extras straight back.
paywall:billing.body__note: The single most important string in the billing flow. Must say progress is untouched BEFORE offering the fix, because the fear is losing the streak, not the cosmetics.
paywall:billing.fix__note: Opens the store's payment settings. Max 18 characters.
paywall:error.failed: That didn't go through. Nothing was charged.
paywall:error.failed__note: Purchase failure. The second sentence matters more than the first — the immediate fear is being charged for nothing.
